description: This PHP script serves as the main page for the TestLink open-source testing management system. It handles user session initialization, retrieves user and project data, manages permissions, and renders the main interface via Smarty templates. The script also includes functions for obtaining user documentation and access rights, and integrates various project-specific logic for navigating test plans and test projects.
